steps.text: Enter Port Phasmatys.

items.name: Ecto-token, or travel by Charter Ship

steps.text: Talk to Velorina in east Port Phasmatys.
choices: Yes, I do. It is a very sad story.

steps.text: Talk to Necrovarus at the Ectofuntus.
Enter Port Phasmatys.

items.name: Ecto-token, or travel by Charter Ship

steps.text: Return to Velorina in east Port Phasmatys.
Talk to the Old Crone east of the Slayer Tower.
Use the nettle tea on the porcelain cup.
Use the bucket of milk on the porcelain cup.
Talk to the Old Crone east of the Slayer Tower.
Talk to the Old Crone and offer to help.
choices: You are doing so much for me - is there anything I can do for you?
I am afraid I have lost the boat you gave to me.

steps.text: Use the silk on the model ship.
Attempt to search the chest in the east of the hull of the ship west of Port Phasmatys. A giant lobster will spawn you need to kill.
Kill the Giant Lobster.
Search the chest in the east of the hull again.
Use the key on the chest in the Captain's Room, then search it.
Search the chest in the Captain's Room.
Go to the main deck of the ship.
Go up the ladder in the ship west of Port Phasmatys.
Go across the gangplank to the north.
Jump across the rocks to the chest and search it for a map piece.
Use the map pieces together.
Enter Port Phasmatys.

items.name: Ecto-token, or travel by Charter Ship and 10 ecto-tokens

steps.text: Talk to the Ghost captain at the rowing boat on the docks with your Ring of Charos (a) equipped.
Enter Port Phasmatys.

items.name: Ecto-token, or travel by Charter Ship and 25 ecto-tokens

steps.text: Travel on the rowing boat on the docks.
Dig on the south of the island for a book.
Return to Port Phasmatys with the Ghost Captain.
Enter Port Phasmatys.

items.name: Ecto-token, or travel by Charter Ship

steps.text: Talk to Ak-Haranu.
choices: Okay, wait here - I'll get you your bow.

steps.text: Talk to Robin in the Port Phasmatys pub. Keep playing runedraw until he agrees to sign your bow.
choices: Yes, I'll give you a game.

steps.text: Bring the signed bow to Ak-Haranu.
Enter Port Phasmatys.

items.name: Ecto-token, or travel by Charter Ship

steps.text: Talk to the Ghost Innkeeper.
choices: Do you have any jobs I can do?

steps.text: Use a bucket of slime on the bedsheets.
Talk to Gravingas wearing the bedsheet.
choices: After hearing Velorina's story I will be happy to help out.

steps.text: Alternate talking with the ghost villagers until you have 10 signatures.
Bring the petition to Necrovarus at the Ectofuntus to cause him to drop a bone key.
Talk to Necrovarus at the Ectofuntus until he drops a bone key.
Pick up the bone key.
Go upstairs at the Ectofuntus.
Use the key on the south room's door.
Search the coffin.
Bring the items to the Old Crone east of the Slayer Tower.
Bring a ghostspeak amulet to the Old Crone east of the Slayer Tower.
Talk to Necrovarus at the Ectofuntus.
choices: Let any ghost who so wishes pass on into the next world.

steps.text: Enter Port Phasmatys. You don't need ecto-tokens for this any more.
Talk to Velorina in east Port Phasmatys to finish!
